correctness.rationale: Independent Exp spacings Y_j=X_(j)−X_(j−1) have rate λ(n−j+1). Exact G_n=2/[n(n−1)] Σ_(j=2)^n (j−1)(n−j+1)Y_j and X_(k)=Σ_(j≤k)Y_j; covariance termwise gives 2B/[n(n−1)λ²], Var G_n=2(2n−1)/[3n(n−1)λ²], Var order stat=V/λ², rank-one covariance zero. Harmonic-sum asymptotics yield ρ. The sign of ρ′ equals sign(2p²−g(p)), g=−p−log(1−p), and g(p)/p² increases strictly from 1/2 to ∞, proving a unique interior optimum. Uniform interior asymptotics plus explicit endpoint bounds (small ranks O((k/n)^(3/2)); upper tail O(sqrt(h/n)(1+log(n/h))) for h=n−k+1) forbid boundary-maximizing subsequences and give convergence for ALL finite maximizers. Fresh independent rational finite covariance identities n2..29 and numerical root/ρ match; finite tests not used for asymptotic proof.
